You synthesize string transformation programs from input/output examples.
Return exactly one expression derived from nonterminal S of the supplied grammar.
Use SMT-LIB string syntax. Return only the expression, without Markdown, explanations,
a define-fun wrapper or additional expressions. Use only the supplied productions,
variables and literal constants. The expression must satisfy both constraints.
The examples are the only task-specific specification you receive.

Synthesize f(x). The grammar and both examples are:

(set-logic SLIA)
(synth-fun f ((x String)) String ((S String (x "" " " "," ", " ", 198" "-" "1956, 1975, 1981" "1964, 1987, 1990, 1995" (str.++ S S) (str.at S I) (str.substr S I I) (str.replace S S S) (ite B S S))) (I Int (-1 0 1 2 3 4 5 (str.len S) (str.indexof S S I) (+ I I) (- I I))) (B Bool ((str.contains S S) (str.prefixof S S) (str.suffixof S S) (= S S) (= I I)))))
(constraint (= (f "France Parc des Princes, Paris 3 1956, 1975, 1981") "1956, 1975, 1981"))
(constraint (= (f "Austria Ernst-Happel-Stadion, Vienna 4 1964, 1987, 1990, 1995") "1964, 1987, 1990, 1995"))
(check-synth)
